meta.title: Rites map — shading data (country-level presence, heartlands, estimates)

boundaries.dataset: Natural Earth Admin 0 – Countries (1:110m for world view, 1:50m for Middle East/India inset)
boundaries.rights: public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)
boundaries.join_key: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; use Natural Earth's ISO_A2_EH field (ISO_A2 is -99 for a few countries) — check during build
boundaries.disputed_borders_note: Natural Earth draws de facto boundaries; add a visible disclaimer that borders are illustrative and imply no position.

data_licensing.GCatholic: © GCatholic.org; facts (country lists, counts) used with attribution and link; do not copy pages/maps. robots.txt permits crawling except /temp/.
data_licensing.CNEWA: © CNEWA; cite figures with attribution; do not rehost PDFs.
data_licensing.Annuario Pontificio: © Libreria Editrice Vaticana; figures cited via CNEWA.

palette.name: Okabe–Ito (Color Universal Design)
palette.note: Hex values are the widely published Okabe–Ito set; the jfly page shows them as a figure — re-check against it during build. Always pair colour with hatch pattern + text label; never rely on colour alone. Sequential layers (counts): ColorBrewer single-hue Blues (https://colorbrewer2.org/).

meta.phase2_note: Copied from the research folder on 2026-10-26 with population_estimates and population_policy removed: Phase 2 shows no population numbers.
